newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks push up again, consolidation seen.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks push up again, consolidation seen.

text.p: MADRID, June 26 (Reuter) 0900 GMT - Madrid stocks nudged up, although off earlier highs, on Thursday, with dealers eyeing possible consolidation after their latest record-breaking run.
Stocks are seen gaining momentum again short-term.
BBV continued to climb sharply, although it was off earlier highs. The bank added 120 pesetas to 12,110.
The general index opened up 3.38 points, 0.56 percent, to a new high at 605.29. At 0900 GMT the Ibex was up 11.95 points, 0.17 percent, to 6,925.12.
Telephone equipment firm Amper was up 90 pesetas to 4,250 after it said profits in the five months to May rose 57 percent, but forecast flat full year results versus 1996.
